comparison_rules: Keep paper87.51/75.32 separate from released README87.54/75.10; neither is a local result.
Frozen encoder rows are task-trained downstream models, not zero-shot whole-model baselines.
Paper SF includes semantic slot content; not interchangeable with S_present type-only metric.
Official original TEST literature score cannot be compared as matched gain against filtered clean TEST or internal TRAIN-selection.
Only paired source Stage1-to-RL same-population curves establish local RL gain; external supervised baselines position task capability.
